text: Who makes winds His messengers, Flames of fire His ministers.
You set a boundary [for the waters] that they may not cross over, So that they will not return to cover the earth.
He waters the mountains from His upper chambers; The earth is satisfied with the fruit of His works.
Where the birds make their nests; As for the stork, the fir trees are her house.
Man goes out to his work And remains at his labor until evening.
There the ships [of the sea] sail, And Leviathan [the sea monster], which You have formed to play there.
You send out Your Spirit, they are created; You renew the face of the ground.
Let sinners be consumed from the earth, And let the wicked be no more. Bless and affectionately praise the LORD, O my soul. Praise the LORD! (Hallelujah!)
